name: @qu/services
description: The Entity API - the layer apps actually call. Hides Qu paths and QuBit envelopes behind plain async methods returning plain values. This slice: paths, unwrap, sync-freshness, and ListService (docs/v3-technical-concept.md §4.2's derived/curated list primitive). No @qu/core dependency yet - none of this slice's source imports it (see @qu/foundation's phantom-dependency finding for why that distinction is kept honest); @qu/core is a devDependency here, for tests only.
